title: structures/<id>.jsonc
description: One structure (game design 2.5). Whole numbers are bare; a number with a fraction is text, such as "2.5".

id.description: The structure's ID. It must equal the file name and be in the roster in rules.jsonc.

track.description: The track whose tier the structure's look shows, from tracks.jsonc. Leave it out for a structure that shows none.

unlock_tier.description: The tier of "track" the owner needs to place the structure. Leave it out for a structure that is there from the start.

footprint.description: The side of the square of tiles the structure stands on.

hp.description: Hit points at Protection 1. Each Protection tier of the owner multiplies them.

cost.description: The price. For a wall, of one tile.

build_seconds.description: Build time in seconds. It must be a whole number of ticks.

sight.description: Sight range in tiles when finished.

territory_radius.description: The radius in tiles of the territory the structure gives its owner when finished.

research_slots.description: Research slots the structure gives its owner when finished.

max_per_player.description: The most a player may have, counting those under way.

trains.description: What the structure trains, in the order it is offered: "worker", or a line ID from the roster whose file names this structure in "built_at".

work_site.description: The resource workers earn at the structure. How many it holds and what each earns are in resources.jsonc.

attack.description: How the structure attacks when finished. The attack is always ranged.

dps.description: Damage per second at Firepower 1. Each Firepower tier of the owner multiplies it.

interval_seconds.description: Seconds between attacks. It must be a whole number of ticks.

range.description: Range in tiles, measured from the nearest edge of the footprint.

projectile_speed.description: How fast a shot flies, in tiles per second.

can_hit_all_from_protection.description: The owner's Protection tier from which "cannot_hit" no longer applies.

wall.description: Makes the structure the wall, which is laid tile by tile. Its footprint must be 1.

gate.description: A wall tile its owner's units can walk through. It has the wall's hit points and sight.

build_seconds.description: Build time in seconds. It must be a whole number of ticks.

id.description: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.

number.description: A whole number, or text in plain decimal notation such as "2.5". A bare number with a fraction is not accepted, so that every value is read exactly.
